@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Seeming Memories
@category:  Base
@class:     Enchanter
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Relive Experience | 1 target | 1 rnd/5 fail | 100' | Fm
 2 | Memory Cue | 1 target | - | 100' | Fm
 3 | Mind Tap | 1 target | - | 100' | Fm

20 | Tap Spell X | caster + 1 tgt | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | Fm
25 | Mass Shared Experience | 1 target/lvl | 1 rnd/5 fail | 100' | Fm
30 | Lord Tap Spell | caster + 1 tgt | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | Fm
50 | Tap Spell True | caster + 1 tgt | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | Fm

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster causes the target to relive an experience chosen by the caster at
time of casting. If the target is in a relaxed state of mind, the target will
be in a reverie and oblivious to his surroundings unless disturbed (loud
noise, physical prod, etc.). If the target is active, the target will remain
active but be distracted by momentary flashbacks and the attempts of his mind
to relate the experience to the current situation (-20 to all actions). This
spell will also provide the target with a +25 bonus to recalling specific
details of the remembered experience. This bonus is not cumulative with Force
Recall or Recall spells.
@@ 2
The caster can select a topic and obtain one cue per level of the caster from
the target. Each cue will relate to an experience of the target with respect
to the topic. These cues are used as the triggers for the Relive and Share
Experience spells.
@@ 3
Caster can assess the target’s ability (in terms of skill ranks) with regard
to one specific skill or spell list chosen at time of casting.
@@ 4
As Relive Experience, except that a second target shares the remembering of
the experience of the principal target. The caster must choose which target is
to be the principal target at time of casting.
@@ 5
Allows the caster to improve the target’s memory for the duration of this
spell. The caster may choose to limit the topics on which the improvement will
be obtained. Any maneuver involving Memory receives a special bonus of +10.
This is not cumulative with Force Recall II, Recall or Relive Experience
spells.
@@ 6
Caster can temporarily tap the language skills of the target, enabling the
caster to use one language at the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the
target. The language must be chosen at time of casting. For the duration of
this spell, the caster must use the target’s skill at the given language, even
if the target is less fluent than the caster in the chosen language.
@@ 7
As Share Experience II, except three targets relive the chosen experience.
@@ 8
As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one purely mental skill of the
target (that would be any skill that uses either Memory or Reasoning as one of
it’s stat bonuses). For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus
with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.
@@ 9
As Share Experience II, except five targets relive the chosen experience.
@@ 10
Caster receives surface thoughts from target, learns the reasoning and the
thought patterns behind the surface thoughts, and may additionally scan the
target’s conscious memories, at a rate of one scene every round. If the target
makes his RR by more than 25, he realizes that someone is trying to read his
thoughts. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.
@@ 11
As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one physical (any skill that uses
either Strength, Agility, or Constitution as one of it’s stat bonuses, except
OB related skills) or mental skill of the target (as defined in Tap Skill II).
For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the
target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.
@@ 12
The caster can remove one thought or memory from the target’s mind each round.
@@ 13
As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one combat skill (OB related skill)
of the target. For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with
that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.
@@ 14
Caster can copy one thought or memory from the target into his own mind each
round.
@@ 15
Caster may use one spell list (chosen at time of casting) of the target
accessing the spell knowledge up to 5th level or the number of skill ranks
possessed by the target (whichever is lower). For the duration of this spell,
the caster’s knowledge of the spell list is limited to the knowledge possessed
by the target. The caster must use his own PPs and must always make a Spell
Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate penalties taken into
consideration. Any failed spells suffer a special modification of +50 to all
spell failure results (i.e., add +50 to all spell failure rolls).
@@ 16
As Force Recall I, except any maneuver Memory receives a special bonus of +25.
@@ 17
As Share Experience II, except ten targets relive the chosen experience.
@@ 18
As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target’s subconscious memories (i.e.,
all experiences).
@@ 19
As Copy Experience, except the caster can copy one thought or memory from his
mind into the mind of the target.
@@ 20
As Tap SpellV, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 10th
level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is
lower).
@@ 25
As Share Experience II, except one target per level of the caster relive the
chosen experience.
@@ 30
As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 20th
level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is
lower).
@@ 50
As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 50th
level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is
lower).
